finding.headline: "The 200-Item Spreadsheet Paralysis"
finding.problem: "Every list says something different. One says a wipe warmer is essential, another says it's a scam. I have ₦/£X to spend and I'm terrified I'll buy the wrong thing and waste it on a baby who won't even use it."
finding.person: 28-yr-old Nigerian mum-to-be in Lagos/diaspora, 20 weeks pregnant, opened 5 baby-checklist blogs and now has a 4-page list she's afraid to buy from.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (umbrella product = the "New Parent Minimalist Setup").". Verdict: PASSES (5/5) —.
